title: Nutritious Chinese Smoked Turkey Broth
description: A sweet, silky, and energizing Chinese dish featuring smoked turkey neck and rest-meat, suitable for breakfast or dinner.
instructions: Combine smoked turkey neck, diced rest-meat, yunnan pepper, star anise, ginger, and cinnamon stick in a large stockpot.
Add salt, black pepper, and light soy sauce to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in water, making sure all ingredients are submerged.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding solids.
Return the pot to high heat and bring the broth to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the broth cool slightly.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding any solids.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
